body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/34786

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/1484

## What I found

The prepared `main` checkout already contains the reported fix. Upstream PR #27998 added the defensive `mamba_next_track_idx is None -> 0` selection, and PR #30437 added the complete lazy/spec planning and post-verify lifecycle. I therefore did not duplicate or alter the runtime implementation.

This PR adds a focused regression and the required investigation artifacts. The regression uses a real GPU-resident ping-pong mapping and covers the fresh-request `None` state, mixed initialized/uninitialized requests, and the explicit lazy-spec track-plan override. It also verifies that metadata construction does not mutate a fresh request's allocation state.

## Reproduction and tests

The fetched pre-#27998 tensor expression reproduces:

`TypeError: 'NoneType' object cannot be interpreted as an integer`

Commands:

```bash
ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-46079851b04a/venv/bin/python reports/j-46079851b04a/reproduce_pre_fix.py
ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-46079851b04a/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/managers/test_mamba_track_indices.py
ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-46079851b04a/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/managers/test_schedule_batch_prepare_for_decode.py test/registered/unit/managers/test_batch_result_processor_mamba_boundary.py
```

Results: the pre-fix expression reproduced the exception; the new regression passed 3 tests; adjacent lifecycle coverage passed 3 tests and 2 subtests. GPU execution was on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (`gfx950`).

## Limitations

The Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 weights and the reported two NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPUs were unavailable. This does not claim a full-model, NVIDIA, semantic-accuracy, or multi-GPU reproduction. The deterministic tiny Llama fixture is not a hybrid-mamba architecture and would not qualify this issue, so it was not used. No native source changed, and no native rebuild was applicable.
